request_id.description: Stable unique idempotency key for this booking request. Reuse it on retries.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the caller confirms the read-back appointment details.

patient_name.description: Required. The name the appointment is booked under; it may differ from the caller's name. Use the exact name the caller stated and confirmed. Never invent, complete, translate, normalize, or substitute a sample, placeholder, or another caller's name. If unclear, ask the caller to repeat or spell it.

phone_number.description: Required. Use only a caller-spoken and caller-confirmed reachable number, or verified incoming Exotel caller ID exposed in call context after caller confirmation. Never guess digits or use the clinic phone number. If caller ID is unavailable, ask the caller for a number and repeat it back for confirmation.

doctor_name.description: Exact doctor name returned by clinic_info or availability.
